title: Character Feature
description: Schema for a character feature in the game

foundryID.description: The source system's stable record identifier

traits.description: List of traits associated with this feature

grantedSpells.description: Spells this feature grants: focus spells and focus cantrips join the class's focus source; known spells join its repertoire or spellbook, and the known-choice spells are one choice between them.

curriculum.description: A wizard school's curriculum: the spells of each rank (0 for cantrips).

spellcasting.description: A caster's slots and spell picks, written once, as the book's table. Authoring shorthand: reading the archive expands it into the record's first rules (configure-source, increase-source-proficiency, grant-slot and add-known-spell), with IDs derived from the record's path. `source` is {kind, tradition, attribute} to define a source, or an @ reference to the feature that defines it; `slots` maps a level to its cumulative row (cantrips, then ranks 1-10); `spellbook` maps a level or range (2-20) to its picks (cantrips, rank-N, any-rank, new-slots).

source.description: {kind, tradition, attribute}, or an @ reference to the feature that defines the source

tradition.description: For a block that adds to another record's source and picks from a tradition list

ids.description: The folder whose name the rule IDs derive from, when it is not features

choose.description: One more spellbook pick, from exactly these spells (@ references)
